question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class WebChat/Control UI shortcut or prompt-snippet browser, and which surface should own the shortcut definitions and storage?
rationale: The request is useful UI ergonomics, but the implementation changes product surface, config/storage, and possibly plugin or command metadata contracts; source inspection shows no existing canonical owner for arbitrary user prompt snippets.

options.title: Design shared shortcut metadata first
options.body: Create or extend a maintained command/skill/plugin metadata contract so the UI browser is backed by one canonical owner instead of a WebChat-only config file.

options.title: Keep it browser-local
options.body: Implement a Control UI-local shortcut list with import/export or local profile storage, avoiding gateway config but limiting cross-device sharing.

options.title: Defer to plugin UI work
options.body: Hold this request until the generic Control UI plugin-panel direction is settled, then make shortcuts a plugin or bundle surface.

recommendation.title: Design shared shortcut metadata first
recommendation.body: Create or extend a maintained command/skill/plugin metadata contract so the UI browser is backed by one canonical owner instead of a WebChat-only config file.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product-surface decision across Control UI, config, and plugin boundaries, and steipete is the strongest recent routing signal available from current-main UI history.
